We had the absolute pleasure of working with Ms. Niharika during our onboarding process with GoKwik, and we couldn't have asked for a better representative to guide us through it.
From the very beginning, Niharika was not only prompt and professional but also extremely patient and supportive. She walked us through each step of the documentation and KYC submission process with utmost clarity, ensuring there was no confusion or delay. Her attention to detail and willingness to go the extra mile truly stood out.
What really made a difference was her human approach—she was always just a message away, ready to resolve queries, provide updates, and encourage us through the process. It’s rare to come across someone so committed, calm, and courteous, especially when dealing with technical procedures. People like her are absolute gems in customer support roles and are the reason onboarding journeys feel smooth and stress-free.
We genuinely appreciate her efforts and wish her nothing but success and happiness in all her future endeavors. Thank you, Niharika, for being a shining example of professionalism and empathy. Warm regards, Cell- Vitals Nutrition

We've been using Magic Checkout by Razorpay for a few months now, and the difference is undeniable. The checkout experience is smooth, fast, and truly customer-friendly—which has directly contributed to a noticeable uplift in our conversion rates. The integration was quick and hassle-free, and the support team has been incredibly responsive and helpful throughout.
We especially love how Magic Checkout intelligently pre-fills customer details and optimizes the checkout journey. It’s clear that a lot of thought has gone into the UX. Highly recommend it to any Shopify store looking to improve their checkout flow and boost sales.
Keep up the great work, team!

We recently integrated Razorpay Magic Checkout on our website sreevaradha.co, and the results have been excellent. The checkout process is now much faster and smoother for our customers, with auto-filled details and multiple payment options in one screen. It has helped reduce cart abandonment and improved the overall shopping experience. Highly recommended for businesses looking to simplify payments and boost conversions.

We have been using GoKwik COD for over a year now and was working fine with whatever limited features they offer. However, over the last 2 months, we have noticed a functionality issue with cancellation of COD orders in their app with stock not getting added back to inventory even though restock option is selected. Their support staff, Ankush claimed it was not their fault and closed the ticket. After sharing more specific information and how the app should work, they realised the issue but are now ignoring it.
Time to get rid of GoKwik and look for another working app.
